mapper.select: SELECT game_id, skill_key, name, description, max_level, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skills WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.skills SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, max_level = #{maxLevel}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = now() WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.skills WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey}
DELETE FROM public.skill_category_relations WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey}
